mapper.select: SELECT message_type AS value, name AS label FROM sys_message_subscription WHERE user_id IS NULL AND is_default = 1 ORDER BY sort, uuid

SELECT d.message_type AS messageType, d.menu_id AS menuId, d.name, d.detail, COALESCE(s.enabled, d.enabled) AS enabled FROM sys_message_subscription d LEFT JOIN sys_message_subscription s ON s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.message_type = d.message_type AND s.is_default = 0 WHERE d.user_id IS NULL AND d.is_default = 1 ORDER BY d.sort, d.uuid
SELECT message_type AS messageType, menu_id AS menuId, enabled FROM sys_message_subscription WHERE message_type = #{messageType} AND user_id IS NULL AND is_default = 1 ORDER BY uuid LIMIT 1

SELECT u.uuid FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_message_subscription s ON s.user_id = u.uuid AND s.message_type = #{messageType} AND s.is_default = 0 WHERE u.status = 1 AND COALESCE(s.enabled, #{defaultEnabled}) = 1
AND u.uuid IN
#{userId}
ORDER BY u.uuid
